investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tidallane Bank (digital banking); Platform: Microsoft Azure southeastasia (zones southeastasia-1/southeastasia-2/southeastasia-3); network range 10.67.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster tidall-prod-southe (AKS); External dependency: push-notifier calls a push notification service (push.notifly.net) protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
